headline: Flood of legislative opinions on real estate taxes; government weighs “non-residence exception requirements”
summary: Over 2,000 public opinions have been submitted on the Comprehensive Real Estate Tax Act, with demands to reflect childcare, caregiving and remodeling. The government is weighing non-residence exception requirements.
why: Real estate tax rules affect housing demand, property values and household balance sheets, which matter for the Korean economy and banks' mortgage exposure.
